notes.title: Another Small Bugfix and balancing (0.9.2.2)
notes.notes:
Chips Changes

 Fixed the localization issues with Chips M2 Y2 and C2
 Hoarder [C5] - increased the chance to gain Max Health when switching the gamecolor to cyan.


Other Adjustments

Let us know if you encounter any further bugs or issues and have Fun!

notes.title: Early Access Patch #1
notes.notes:
Here is the changelog for the first Early Access Patch (version 0.9.2)
If anything is unclear about the patch, or you would like to give ideas or feedback, tell us in the comments or the community tab! :D

Gameplay Adjustments:

 Level 0 was made easier (only 4 minutes and Crawler is introduced in Level 1)
 Level 11, Level 12 & Level 13 are now playable!


Additive Changes:

 Fast And Wide (increased Attack Speed)
 Combo Master (decreased Attack Range but increased Final Slash Attack Range, no longer grants more Slashes In Combo)
 Phase Dash (now deals 200% instead of 300% Attack Damage)
 Lightsaber (bigger/boss projectiles can no longer be reflected)
 Reduced all sources of Dash Length and Dash Invincibility
 Slightly reduced the Experience Gain from upgraded Additives


Chips Changes:

 Added a new row of Chips as the second row. And moved around some of the other Chips.
 One of the new Chips now grants an option to toggle switch the Auto Attack.


Interface Adjustments:

 New Additive unlocked text now hides itself after a while
 Newly unlocked Additives now show their tooltip after the animation
 In the win/death screen, the Additive Tree button now also directly triggers the unlock animation
 Fixed a bug where the next row of chips would be unlocked even if the previous row did not have a chip at max level.
 Improved the look of the player stats display


Other Adjustments:

 Fixed a game-breaking bug that occurred late in the game when all Additives were upgraded to +3 and the game could not find any more Additives to upgrade. (In this case you can now choose a normal Additive instead - this may change in the future!)
thanks to the feedback of ashdust and Nuarc20
 Movement can now be rebound on keyboard
 Cursor is no longer confined in windowed mode
 Various minor QOL changes and bug fixes


Have fun with the new update and let us know if you encounter any further bugs or issues!
- Team Dash

notes.title: Release Date is changing!
notes.notes:
We never thought we would be one of those companies that announce a change in release date.
Our game is coming when it's Rdy!
Jokes aside, instead of delaying the game, we are actually going to release it earlier.

Dash x Survivors is now coming to Early Access on May 13! (Oh boi, that's only 9 days away)

This is due to clashes with events that we cannot fully disclose yet. But only good things, we promise.
We are also not under any time pressure. At least not more than before. (help)

So be happy with us and spread the word!
Dash Slash Die Repeat ~
